properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Abanoonya erinnya lyo,
Era n'abatukuvu bo
Emirembe n'emirembe.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Laba-eggye ly'abatukuvu
Wamu n'abo tusanyuke;
Era bwe mba nga nzirise
Linzizaamu nnyo amaanyi

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Tetubalaba kaakano
Baamala okuwunguka;
Naffe tuli mu lugendo
Tulibeera wamu nabo

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Fenna awamu tuli mu ggwe,
Tetubalaba n'amaaso,
Naye olw'okukkiriza
Tuli mu kisibo kimu.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Mu maaso go ffe awamu,
Bulijjo tutendereza;
Mu mwoyo tulabagana,
Ne twebaza ekisa kyo.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Eggye lyonna-ery'omu ggulu
Abo be ndibeera nabo;
Era naawe Omwagalwa,
Ani alitwawukanya?
